verdicts.reason: rtspd credential check contains hard-coded magic suffix ":?*": any base64-decoded Authorization value ending in ":?*" returns authenticated ('no pssswd' path) without comparing real credentials - a hard-coded backdoor credential granting RTSP video stream access; reachable on the DESCRIBE auth path whenever RTSP authentication is enabled (factory default Authenticate=0 means no auth at all, empty admin password by default).

verdicts.vuln_type: authentication-bypass / information-disclosure (insufficient validation of RTSP session authentication)
verdicts.endpoint: RTSP service, port 554 - SETUP/PLAY/TEARDOWN with Session: header (no DESCRIBE/auth required)
verdicts.parameter: Session: header value (accepted unvalidated via atoi)

sink.func: strstr(req,"Session:") + atoi(p+8) stored as session id with no validation; authenticationOK only invoked from DESCRIBE branch (single call site 0xf67c)

evidence: grep 'bl.*11f1' rtspd.asm: authenticationOK(0x11f14) has exactly ONE call site 0xf67c, inside handleCmd_DESRIBE (0xe10c) reached only from dispatcher DESCRIBE branch (0xceb4 strcmp, 0xcf18 bl) - SETUP (0xf8c8), PLAY (0x100ec), TEARDOWN, PAUSE branches perform no authentication

arm-linux-gnueabi-objdump -d rtspd: 0xfa8c strstr(request, 0x1a97c="Session:"); 0xfad4 bl atoi(p+8) -> str r3,[r4,#52] - client-supplied session id accepted without checking it was issued by the server

arm-linux-gnueabi-objdump -d rtspd: session id generator 0x112b0 = srand(gettimeofday sec+usec) @0x112fc, 1+(int)((double)rand()*100000.0/2147483648.0) (double consts @0x11374=100000.0, @0x1137C=2^31) -> session ids in [1,100000], guessable range

strings -a sbin/rtspd | grep -i cookie -> no output; strings -a sbin/rtpd | grep -iE 'cookie|auth' -> no output - no HTTP-cookie auth exists, CVE's 'authentication cookies for the RTSP session' is the RTSP Session identifier; web UI cookies are language-preference only (var/www/index.html)

companion process check (4.e): /sbin/rtpd IPCServer binds 127.0.0.1 (string @0x16570), Listener::handleStart(request->port) starts RTP streaming purely on rtspd's IPC command, rtpd contains zero authentication logic - streaming decision rests entirely on rtspd's unauthenticated SETUP/PLAY handling
verdicts.reason: RTSP session authentication is only enforced on DESCRIBE (single auth call site); SETUP accepts any client-supplied Session: id via atoi without validation and PLAY/TEARDOWN never re-authenticate, and server-issued ids are only 1..100000 - a malicious user obtains unauthorized access to the video streams without valid credentials (factory default [RTPServer] Authenticate=0 disables even the DESCRIBE check).
